title: Passenger Medical Event
event: Passenger reports severe chest pain and requests immediate help.
context: Vehicle is safely stopped. Passenger remains responsive. Location and emergency-access information are available.

hold.feedback: Critical error: safe stop alone does not satisfy the defined emergency-response requirement.

context.feedback: Passenger condition and location context confirmed. Emergency action is required.

guidance.feedback: Critical error: routine operational guidance is inappropriate for a medical emergency.

escalate.feedback: Medical emergency immediately escalated through the emergency-response path.
